{{Quote|Four hundred craft incoming on our starboard-aft quarter, moving on attack vectors. Identification: vulture droids.|Hammerly reports the situation during the battle of Umbara|<ref name="Thrawn" />}}
'''Hammerly''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as a [[chief sensor officer]] of the [[Imperial Navy]] in the [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War]]. She served under [[Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] aboard the [[starship]] ''[[Thunder Wasp]]'' during the [[battle over Umbara]] as a [[Senior Lieutenant]]. Following the [[Cyphar Incident]], Hammerly stalled Thrawn's superiors, who were furious due to his actions in the event.<ref name="Thrawn" /> Hammerly was eventually promoted to the rank of commander and served under Thrawn, now a [[commodore]], for a second [[time]] aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Chimaera]]''. She participated in [[Imperial–Grysk conflict|battles against the Grysks]]<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances" /> and in a [[skirmish against the Third Fleet]].<ref name="Thrawn: Treason">''[[Thrawn: Treason]]''</ref>

==Biography==
{{Quote|Commander, inform Governor Pryce I'm departing for Coruscant. As soon as you have your course, make the jump into hyperspace.|Grand Admiral Thrawn, to Commander Hammerly|<ref name="Jedi Night">{{Rebels|Jedi Night}}</ref>}}
Due to [[Hera Syndulla]]'s failed attack against the Lothal factory and the theft of the Defender Elite, [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin|Tarkin]] called the ''Chimaera'' to discuss the funding for Thrawn's TIE/D Defender program with Emperor Palpatine. Thrawn asked Commander Hammerly to have [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] informed about his immediate departure to [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Jedi Night" /> En route to the meeting on Coruscant, Hammerly informed Thrawn that ''Chimaera'' received a new set of coordinates from Tarkin to rendezvous with him in the [[Sev Tok system]] aboard the ISD ''[[Firedrake]]'', the flagship of the Empire's [[Third Fleet]] led by Grand Admiral [[Balanhai Savit]].<ref name="Thrawn: Treason" />
